description:
Sehr schönes Haus mit 10 Parteien in einer verkehrsberuhigten Zone an der Ecke Fundsbergstaße / Isenburgstrasse. Das Objekt wurde 1990 erbaut und ist in einem sehr gepflegten Zustand. Die Frundsbergstrasse ist eine der attraktivsten Straßen in Neuhausen. Hier finden Sie Strassencafes, Galerien und Kunsthandwerk.

Die Wohnung befindet sich im 4 OG und ist mit Lift barrierefrei erreichbar. Alle Zimmer, auch Bad und Küche, haben Fenster. Der Balkon ist nach Westen ausgerichtet. Die Wohnung ist mit Ahornparkett und einer Poggenpohl-Küche ausgestattet. Darüber hinaus ist ein hochwertiger Flat-TV und Internet-Zugang vorhanden. Die Wohnung ist vollständig möbliert. title: Südparkallee, Munich
description:
Amazing, spacious studio in excellent location
Light-flooded, very bright in all rooms penthouse apartment.
The surrounding roof terrace with LED lighting is perfect for barbecuing with friends or even for winding down after a hard day's work.
The large panoramic window in the living room with southern exposure can be opened completely. This creates an open living feeling with a view into the well-kept garden, which can be shared by the entire house.
The location close to the center is very convenient in a well-kept residential area with many individual houses, villas with gardens. Also the large Südpark, with high recreational value is right next door.
First occupancy after elaborate, stylish renovation and modernization.
Sendling is one of the southwestern districts of Munich with excellent traffic connections, by car and public transport.
The popular bathing area Flaucher at the zoo Hellabrunn is quickly reached.
The extensive park "Südpark" is right on your doorstep. This park offers extensive walking paths, sunbathing lawns, several children's playgrounds, a fitness trail, table tennis tables, a skating rink, curling lanes and a toboggan run in winter.
In addition, you will find numerous restaurants, a wide range of stores and medical facilities as well as everything for your daily needs in the immediate vicinity.
Excursion destinations, such as Lake Starnberg, Garmisch-Partenkirchen, towards the south-west are quickly reached via the nearby freeway connection.
Via the middle ring road you can reach the freeway to Salzburg in 15 minutes, so you can reach the alpine region with attractive destinations at any time of the year uncomplicated and fast
By car you can reach the main train station, 7 km away, in 15 minutes, by public transport in 25 minutes.



Hochwertig modernisierte Penthouse Wohnung Sendling
Lichtdurchflutete, in allen Räumen sehr helle Penthouse-Wohnung.
Die umlaufende Dachterrasse mit LED Beleuchtung ist perfekt zum Grillen mit Freunden oder auch zum Ausklingen eines anstrengenden Arbeitstages.
Das große Panoramafenster im Wohnzimmer mit südlicher Ausrichtung lässt sich komplett öffnen. Dadurch entsteht ein offenes Wohngefühl mit Blick in den gepflegten Garten, der gemeinschaftlich vom gesamten Haus genutzt werden kann.
Die zentrumsnahe Lage ist sehr verkehrsgünstig in einer gepflegten Wohngegend mit vielen Einzelhäusern, Villen mit Gärten. Auch der große Südpark, mit hohem Freizeitwert ist direkt nebenan.
Erstbezug nach aufwendiger, stilsicherer Renovierung und Modernisierung.

- Hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung, mit Auto und den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln

title: Hanebergstraße, Munich
description:
ALL-INCLUSIVE TEMPORARY LIVING

Are you in town for a short time or are you simply looking for more living space?

In the Bavarian capital, 16 fully furnished and equipped apartments are waiting to be filled with life. It doesn't matter if you're only in town for a short time or for a longer period - with our flexible rental periods you can be part of our family for between 1 and 6 months. With us you not only get an apartment, but a complete package of modern living space and a lively community and extensive services! Your all-in price covers all the needs that make your everyday life unique:

Generous common rooms offer a variety of opportunities to relax, work and network with each other. Get to know your roommates in the cozy lounge or while cooking in the fully equipped communal kitchen. In the co-working space, you can concentrate on your work or exchange ideas with others. Between the working sessions, you can relax on the large roof terrace. The hip nightlife district of Maxvorstadt and numerous restaurants are only 10 minutes away.


YOUR HIGHLIGHTS

•	House management and technician services
•	Common areas: roof terrace, lounge area, community kitchen, co-working space, lobby, laundry and drying room
•	Community events: joint excursions in the region and events such as pizza evenings, yoga sessions, cooking classes and much more
•	Parcel acceptance: We accept your parcels at the reception, which you can pick up there during opening hours
•	Loan items: required items such as irons, games, vacuum cleaners and much more can be borrowed free of charge from the reception
•	Partner Deals: With your Member Card you benefit from local partner offers
•	Security: access with security card; intercom in each apartment, CCTV
•	Bicycle cellar: Your bicycle is safe and dry in our bicycle cellar
•	Parking: You are also welcome to rent a parking space for your car.


YOUR FULLY FURNISHED APARTMENT

It doesn’t matter whether you want to move in as a couple or alone, your fully furnished apartment offers you a bright, fully equipped living space coming with a comfortable double bed with a mattress, a dining table, working area, spacious wardrobe with a mirror, light-proof curtains, an intercom system, a chic lounge armchair, TV and numerous storage options.

The galley kitchen is equipped with two ceramic hobs, combination microwave, fridge with freezer compartment, a sink and a counter. You can also prepare a delicious coffee every morning with the existing coffee machine. Cooking utensils such as cutlery, crockery, pots and pans are also available. So, nothing stands in the way of a delicious meal. In some apartments there is also a dishwasher.

The modern, tiled shower room offers additional storage space in addition to the toilet and a vanity with mirror. You are welcome to order towels and bed linen for an extra charge.



YOUR ALL-IN PRICE

You get a complete living concept and not just an apartment! Your all-in price includes the following services:

Apartment services
•	Apartment
•	Furniture
•	Utilities (water, electricity)
•	Internet

Living Services
•	Reception / House Management / House Technician
•	Rental items (vacuum cleaner, iron, games, etc.)
•	Parcel acceptance
•	Common rooms
•	Events

Tip: Benefit from the best offer: The earlier you book and the longer you stay, the better the price offer will be.

💡NOTE:
•  Admission fee:
         ** 6-9 Month = 249€
         **10 Month and more = 99€
•  The deposit is 3x the monthly cold rent.


LOCATION - In the historic district of Neuhausen-Nymphenburg

•	Short distances to many leisure and nightlife options
•	Excellent connection to public transport - there is a bus stop in front of the door, the underground stations "Gern" and "Olympiapark West" can be reached on foot within 10 minutes
•	In the immediate vicinity there are shops for everything you need to live, as well as pharmacies, cafes, and restaurants
•	The Olympic Park is only a few minutes' walk away


JUST BRING YOUR SUITCASE AND MOVE IN

From the moment you move in, our house managers will take care of your concerns to make your living experience perfect. If you'd like to stop by and see the house before you book, simply book a viewing through our calendar and our team will show you around.



*The photos shown are sample images.

**Please note that the rent written on the listing is (hidden) rent. There is a surcharge for quieter apartments facing the courtyard or for apartments on a higher floor level. If you are interested, do let us know and we will send you the offer!

description:
Shared flat of 5 young people. Professionals or interns, graduates  and PhD Students preferred.

Room
The 24 square meter bay room is very bright, has a beautiful parquet floor and a pleasant old building room height. The room is furnished like in the photos, i.a. with a 140 cm wide bed, sofa, armchair, wardrobe, etc. It was renovated in 2023.

Location
Due to its fantastic location near the Isar floodplain (100 meters away), the Au is one of the most popular residential areas in Munich. The Glockenbachviertel with its countless bars and cafes begins just a bridge over the Isar. In 100 meters you can walk to the Isar, where it is wonderful to sit by the water, especially in summer. Bus lines 52 and 62 stop 50 meters from the house, supermarket, pharmacy and bakery are almost right next to the building. Bad:

Der Garten und der Fahrradkeller können durch alle Mieter genutzt werden.

Viele Supermärkte, andere Geschäfte & Restaurants sind in der Nähe. Nur 1 Minute zum Hotwok und Mamma Pizza!

Rauchen ist nur auf dem Balkon gestattet, nicht innerhalb der Wohnung. Die maximale Mietdauer sind 12 Monate. (Kann verlängert werden)

We speak English.

title: Otkerstraße, Munich
description:
Welcome to Otkerstraße 42!

Discover this inviting 3-room shared apartment that combines modern comfort with a friendly atmosphere. This home is ideal for students and young professionals who value communal living.

The Apartment
The furnishings are modern and carefully selected to create a pleasant ambiance. The spacious kitchen invites you to enjoy cozy cooking evenings and shared meals, well-equipped with everything you need—from cutlery and glassware to dishes and modern appliances.

The apartment features two bathrooms: one with a relaxing bathtub and an additional WC that provides extra convenience. The welcoming dining area encourages communal dining and sharing daily experiences, while the generous hallway fosters a friendly, open atmosphere, making the living space even more inviting.

Overall, this apartment offers the perfect environment for those seeking a modern and harmonious lifestyle.

The Room
This sunlit room, measuring a generous 21 square meters, is the largest in the apartment and boasts direct access to the winter garden. The large window floods the space with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.

The room is furnished with a comfortable, large bed that promises restful nights. A practical, spacious desk provides ample space for focused work or study, while the stylish dresser adds extra storage and beautifully complements the wardrobe.

Location Description: Otkerstraße 42, Giesing
Perfectly located for students and early-career professionals, this apartment is situated in a vibrant neighborhood in Giesing, directly at the Wettersteinplatz U-Bahn station. Here, you can enjoy the perfect blend of central urban living and a cozy community.

Public Transport
The Wettersteinplatz U-Bahn station (U2) is just a few steps away, offering you quick and easy access to the city center and important universities and colleges in Munich. This makes getting to your classes or workplace a breeze.

Shopping Options
In the immediate vicinity, you'll find everything you need for daily life. Supermarkets, bakeries, and quaint cafés are all within walking distance. The nearby Giesinger Bahnhof and Giesinger Straße provide a wide variety of shops, perfect for your everyday errands.

Leisure Activities
This location is ideal for sports and leisure enthusiasts. The Grünwalder Stadion is just a short walk away and offers the chance to catch exciting football matches. Additionally, the surrounding parks and green spaces invite you to relax or engage in outdoor activities.

Vibrant Neighborhood
Giesing is characterized by its charming blend of traditional Bavarian culture and modern amenities. Numerous restaurants, bars, and cafés ensure that you can unwind after a long day at university or work while exploring the diverse Munich dining scene.

In summary, Otkerstraße 42 combines tranquility and quality of life with proximity to urban conveniences—perfect for anyone seeking an inspiring and active environment in Munich!

As landlords, we prioritize creating a harmonious and inviting atmosphere for all our residents. We carefully ensure that our tenants are compatible, fostering a pleasant and peaceful coexistence.

Each of our rooms is designed to maximize your comfort and is perfect for those who work from home. With high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the apartment, you’ll enjoy seamless connectivity for all your professional and personal needs. Whether you’re joining video calls, studying, or just streaming your favorite shows, you’ll be well-equipped to do it all.

We believe that living here is more than just having a room—it’s about being part of a welcoming community where everyone feels at home. If you’re looking for a vibrant environment that supports your lifestyle, come check out Otkerstraße 42!

title: Paracelsusstraße, Munich
description:
Room 4 – Quiet and Comfortable (Fully Furnished) + private balcony
Room 4 is an excellent option for anyone looking for a calm and practical living space. Slightly separated from the other rooms, it offers a quieter atmosphere, making it especially suitable for people who value peace and privacy within a shared apartment. The room has a practical layout that makes it easy to place furniture in a way that maximizes both comfort and functionality.
The window lets in natural light, giving the room a welcoming and pleasant vibe throughout the day. Even though it is quiet, the room remains close enough to the kitchen and bathroom for convenience, which is particularly practical in everyday life.
Like all the other rooms in the apartment, Room 4 is fully furnished. You will already find a bed, desk, wardrobe, and seating, so you don’t need to purchase any furniture yourself. This makes settling in extremely easy, especially for students and young professionals moving to Munich for the first time. With some personal decorations, the room quickly becomes a comfortable and cozy retreat.

Location Description – Paracelsusstraße 2, Munich
This apartment impresses not only with its modern features but also with its comfortable and quiet location. Situated in a well-kept residential area, it offers both a peaceful living environment and excellent access to shopping facilities, public transport, and leisure activities.

Public Transport
The connection to public transport is excellent. Bus and subway stations are just a short walk away, providing quick and easy access to Munich’s city center, universities, and workplaces. Frequent connections make this an ideal location for students and young professionals.

Shopping & Daily Needs
A variety of shopping options can be found nearby. There is an Edeka supermarket, Aldi, a Metro wholesale store, and a beverage market for all your daily and weekly needs. A local bakery just around the corner offers fresh bread and pastries. In addition, an Aral gas station is close by, providing both fuel and a convenience shop for everyday essentials.

Fitness & Lifestyle
For those who like to stay active, a FitX fitness studio is nearby, making it easy to integrate fitness into your daily routine. The quiet neighborhood is also perfect for walks or simply enjoying some fresh air after a busy day.
Parking
For tenants with cars, on-street parking is available directly in front of the building, adding another level of convenience.

Summary
Paracelsusstraße combines the benefits of a tranquil residential area with the comfort of having everything close at hand. With excellent public transport, supermarkets, a fitness center, and shops within walking distance, it is an ideal location for anyone looking for a well-connected and peaceful home in Munich.



Kitchen – The Heart of the Apartment (Fully Equipped)
The kitchen is designed to be the social hub of the apartment and offers everything you need for cooking, dining, and spending time with your flatmates. Equipped with modern appliances and functional storage, it makes preparing meals both easy and enjoyable. Here, you will find a stove, oven, refrigerator, and sink, as well as cupboards for storing dishes, groceries, and cooking essentials. The layout has been created to make the best use of the available space, ensuring that everyone can use the kitchen comfortably.
This is not just a practical space – it’s also the place where community life in the flat naturally comes together. Whether it’s preparing breakfast in the morning, cooking dinner with your flatmates in the evening, or simply catching up over a quick snack, the kitchen offers the perfect atmosphere for social interaction. The bright, open design creates a pleasant environment, encouraging both efficiency and relaxation.
The kitchen also comes fully furnished with basic equipment, making it easy to start your new daily routine from day one. All you need to bring are your personal kitchen utensils and perhaps a few favorite items to make it feel like home. For many tenants, the kitchen becomes more than just a cooking space – it’s the heart of the flat, where friendships are built and shared moments take place.

Bathroom – Modern and Functional
The bathroom is modern, well-maintained, and designed with functionality in mind. It is equipped with all the necessary sanitary facilities, including a shower, sink, mirror, and toilet. The layout is efficient, making the most of the available space so that it feels practical without being crowded. Clean tiles and bright lighting give the room a fresh and welcoming appearance, creating a space where you feel comfortable starting and ending your day.
Even in a shared apartment, the bathroom is a place where you can enjoy privacy and quiet moments of self-care. The practical arrangement ensures that it can be used efficiently by multiple flatmates without major delays or waiting times. Storage areas for toiletries and bathroom essentials are available, making it easy to keep everything organized.
Hygiene and cleanliness are key priorities, and the bathroom is set up so that it can be easily maintained by all tenants. Combined with regular cleaning, it remains a pleasant space for everyone. Whether you are rushing in the morning before lectures or work, or winding down with a refreshing shower in the evening, the bathroom provides the comfort and convenience you need in your daily routine.
Hallway – Practical and Welcoming
The hallway is more than just an entrance; it sets the tone for the apartment. It offers enough space to hang coats, store shoes, and keep personal belongings organized, ensuring that the rest of the flat remains uncluttered. The practical design allows everyone to have their designated area, while still maintaining a clean and welcoming look for guests and flatmates alike.
As the central connecting point of the apartment, the hallway provides easy access to all rooms, ensuring smooth movement within the flat. Its layout makes it simple to navigate between the kitchen, bathroom, and bedrooms, creating a well-structured flow in daily life.
Although often underestimated, the hallway plays an important role in keeping the apartment organized. By providing a functional space for outerwear and everyday items, it prevents clutter from building up in the more private rooms. This balance of practicality and simplicity makes the hallway an essential part of the overall living concept, contributing to both comfort and order in the flat.

Balcony – Your Private Outdoor Escape
The balcony is one of the highlights of the apartment, offering an outdoor space that enhances the overall quality of living. Whether you use it to enjoy a peaceful morning coffee, get some fresh air while working from home, or spend summer evenings chatting with your flatmates, the balcony becomes a versatile extension of your living space.
Its size is perfectly suited for a small table and chairs, plants, or other decorative touches, allowing you to create your own little outdoor oasis in the middle of the city. This makes it not just functional but also a lifestyle feature, especially during warmer months.
Having access to a balcony in a shared flat is a real advantage, as it provides a private retreat while still being accessible for everyone. It allows you to step outside without leaving the apartment, creating an instant sense of relaxation and openness. Natural light also streams through the balcony door into the adjacent room, adding brightness and warmth to the interior.
For many tenants, the balcony quickly becomes a favorite spot in the apartment – a place to relax, recharge, and enjoy a small piece of nature in an urban setting.

Other Information

Our rental prices are all-inclusive, meaning that electricity, hot water, high-speed Wi-Fi, and the monthly broadcasting fee (GEZ) are already covered in the rent. This ensures full transparency without hidden costs, making budgeting straightforward and reliable. The minimum rental period is six months, which makes the apartment ideal for students and young professionals who are looking for stability but still want flexibility in their housing arrangement.

The concept of co-living is at the core of our housing philosophy. Co-living is a modern form of shared living where residents enjoy the privacy of their own fully furnished rooms while also benefiting from communal spaces such as the kitchen, bathroom, and balcony. This model strikes a balance between private life and social connection, offering the opportunity to meet like-minded people in a supportive community.

Residents often appreciate co-living not only because it is convenient but also because it provides the chance to build friendships, share experiences, and enjoy cultural exchange. For students beginning their studies, or for young professionals starting their careers in Munich, this arrangement offers an easy and comfortable transition. With everything included in the rent – utilities, Wi-Fi, and GEZ – co-living becomes a stress-free and enriching lifestyle that goes far beyond traditional renting.

title: Kürnbergstraße, Munich
description:
Stylish Shared Room in a Renovated 3-Room Apartment

The tastefully furnished shared room is located in a recently renovated 3-room apartment on the first floor. The high-quality furniture is in excellent condition, providing a comfortable living atmosphere. Spanning 78 m2, the apartment features a stylish design with ceiling spots and real wood parquet, creating a bright and inviting space.

The kitchen is well-equipped, featuring a large refrigerator, a dishwasher, an oven with a ceramic cooktop, and a washing machine. Additionally, there is a laundry room in (hidden)ment with coin-operated washers and dryers.

Our rental prices include all utility costs (electricity, hot water, and high-speed Wi-Fi). The minimum rental period is 6 months.

The infrastructure and public transport connections are exceptionally convenient. 
The S/U-Bahn station "Harras," the U-Bahn station "Partnachplatz," and the S-Bahn station "Mittersendling" are all just a few minutes’ walk away. The major highways to Garmisch-Partenkirchen (A95), Lindau (A96), and Salzburg (A8), as well as the Mittlerer Ring, are easily accessible, allowing you to reach downtown Munich in just 15 minutes.Nearby, you'll find a beverage market, a drugstore, and a large supermarket. Medical facilities, a school, and a daycare center are also within walking distance. For leisure activities, the nearby "Westpark" offers numerous walking and cycling paths, as well as bouldering and climbing walls.

Experience the perfect combination of urban living and the tranquility of a residential area in Mittersendling!

title: Fallmerayerstraße, Munich
description:
The furnished apartment consists of a small bedroom with a 1.40m bed and a large living room with a sofa bed and dining area.
The apartment also has a balcony, is quiet and is on the 2nd floor (with elevator). The apartment is fully furnished. You can directly move in. Various restaurants and supermarkets are nearby. In 8 minutes you can reach the well-known Hohenzollernstrasse and in 14 minutes Münchener Freiheit. The Luitpoldpark as a local recreation area is just around the corner. The English Garden is only about a 15-minute walk away. 
Due to its location directly at the English Garden, Schwabing offers a variety of different leisure activities. You can relax in the Aumeister or Hirschau beer garden, go for long walks or do sports. Streams or the Kleinhesseloher See provide cooling on hot days, and you can ice skate here in winter. With the Seidlvilla, the district has its own venue. Altschwabing has a lively cabaret scene, mainly based around Wedekindplatz and Occamstraße in the Lustspielhaus, the Lach- und Schiessgesellschaft and the clubhouse, the former "Bei Gisela".
Die Wohnung besteht aus einem kleinen Zimmer mit 1,40m Bett und einem großen Wohnzimmer mit einem Sofabett und Essecke.
Die Wohnung hat auch einen Balkon, liegt ruhig und befindet sich im 2.OG (mit Lift). Die Wohnung ist möbliert. Sie können direkt da einziehen.
In der Nähe sind verschieden Restaurants und Supermärkte. In 8 min erreicht man die bekannte Hohenzollernstrasse und in 14 min Münchener Freiheit. Der Luitpoldpark als Naherholungsgebiet befindet sich gleich um die Ecke. Der Englische Garten befindet sich nur ca. 15 Gehminuten entfernt. 
Durch die Lage direkt am Englischen Garten bietet Schwabing eine Vielzahl unterschiedlichster Freizeitmöglichkeiten. Man kann entspannt im Biergarten Aumeister oder Hirschau sitzen, ausgiebige Spaziergänge machen oder sich sportlich betätigen. An heißen Tagen verschaffen Bäche oder der Kleinhesseloher See Abkühlung, im Winter kann hier Schlittschuh gelaufen werden. Mit der Seidlvilla hat der Stadtteil seinen eigenen Veranstaltungsort. Altschwabing verfügt über eine lebendige Kabarettszene, vor allem beheimatet um den Wedekindplatz und die Occamstraße im Lustspielhaus, der Lach- und Schiessgesellschaft und dem Vereinsheim, dem früheren „Bei Gisela“.

title: Badstraße, Munich
description:
Bright 2 room apartment with a large kitchen in Munich-Thalkirchen. The apartment consists of a bedroom with a 1.80m bed and a living room with a sofa bed. The apartment is quiet and is on the 2nd floor. It is furnished and you can move in directly.
 The apartment is 2 minutes from the underground station, 3 minutes from the Isar, 5 minutes from Flaucher and 7 minutes from Hellabrunn Zoo. The Oktoberfest can be reached in 20 minutes by subway. There are a few supermarkets and restaurants nearby. These can also be reached within 2-5 minutes on foot. Marienplatz is 12 minutes away from the apartment.
The area around the apartment is very popular as the Isar is right outside the door. You can go for long walks, sunbathe and get something delicious from the kiosk. Thalkirchen is considered the green lung of Munich - and the Isar meadows are the city's recreation area. Munich residents come to swim, have a barbecue, cycle and run. Tourists come by raft.

Helle 2 Zimmer Wohnung mit großer Küche in MünchenThalkirchen. Die Wohnung besteht aus einem Schlafzimmer mit 1,80m Bett und einem Wohnzimmer mit einer Schlafsofa. Die Wohnung  liegt ruhig und befindet sich im 2.OG .Sie ist möbliert und  Sie können direkt einziehen.
 Die Wohnung ist 2 min von der U-Bahn Station entfernt, 3 min von der Isar, 5 min vom Flaucher und 7 min vom Tierpark Hellabrunn. Mit der U-Bahn erreicht man das Oktoberfest in 20 min. In der Nähe befinden sich einige Supermärkte und Restaurants. Diese sind auch innerhalb von 2-5 min zu Fuß zu erreichen. Marienplatz liegt 12 min von der Wohnung entfernt.
Die Gegend rund um die Wohnung ist sehr beliebt, da die Isar direkt vor der Tür liegt. Man kann ausgedehnte Spaziergänge machen, sich sonnen und sich am Kiosk etwas Leckeres holen. Thalkirchen gilt als die grüne Lunge Münchens - und die Isarauen sind das Erholungsgebiet der Stadt. Die Münchner kommen zum Baden, Grillen, Radfahren und Laufen. Touristen kommen mit dem Floß.

title: Engelhardstraße, Munich
description:
Die Nachbarschaft

Unser Stadtteil Sendling war früher ein Bauerndorf und ist älter als die Stadt München selbst. Es ist ein ruhiges, "normales" Wohnviertel, in dem sich die Nachbarn noch kennen.  In fünf Minuten ist man jeweils entweder im benachbarten Park, oder auch an der neuen Sportanlage Neuhofen, mit Basketball- und Fußballplätzen, Fitnessgeräten, Skaterbahn, die Innenstadt / der Marienplatz ist in 20 Minuten erreichbar, wie auch unser schöner Zoo Hellabrunn und der "Flaucher" - eine wunderschöne Naturregion am nahen Isar-Strand, der zu Fiß oder 7n 10 Min mit dem Bus etreichbar ist. Die Münchner gehen gerne dorthin Schwimmen und veranstalten Grill-Partys am Ufer.
Cafés, Restaurants, Supermärkte finden Sie in der nahen Umgebung, oder am Harras, in der Passauer Straße, oder in der Hofmannstraße. 

Near center, 20 min to Marienplatz, Hauptbahnhof, Zoo, Siemens.

10 min to express highway Salzburg, also Lindau/Garmisch
To find parking places in the neighbourhood is not too difficult.

Zentrumsnah, Gehweg einkalkuliert, 20 Min zum Marienplatz, 14 Min. zum Hauptbahnhof,15 Min zum Tierpark,
10 Minuten mit dem Auto zur Autobahn Salzburg, Lindau, Garmisch
Parkplätze sind im Umkreis von 50 -100m vor 17.00h leicht zu bekommen.


Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel

4 Buslinien Bus 134, Bus 54, Bus 153  und X 204 Dir. Unterhaching sind in 2 Minuten zu erreichen, S-Bahn (S 7 und S 27) in 5 Minuten. Der Bus 53 ist in 8 Gehminuten erreichbar.
U6 (Harras) oder U3(Brudermühlstraße) jeweils 1 Station mit dem Bus, oder 7-10 Minuten zu Fuß.

F e r n v e r k e h r: Die Autobahnen Salzburg und Lindau erreichen Sie in 10-20 Minuten, abhängig vom Verkehrsaufkommen. Die Autobahn Nürnberg ist 20-30 Fahrminuten von uns entfernt.


ESSENSZUBEREITUNG im Zimmer
Wie auf den Fotos abgebildet, 1 Bett, 1Sessel mit Fußhocker, 1 Tisch, 1 Schrank, 1Stuhl, 1 Regal,1 Geschirrkommode mit Kochplatte, 1 Wassekocher
Sie haben einen Wasserkocher und 2 Kochplatten sowie Geschirr im Zimmer, um sich Kleinigkeiten zum Essen zubereiten/ aufwärmen zu können.   Mikrowelle und Kühlschrank stehen im 40 qm großen Flur/mit Eingangshalle zu Ihrer Verfügung, eine Spülmaschine befindet sich im Bad.  
Bitte spülen Sie ihr Geschirr ausschließlich in der Spülmaschine.
Waschmaschine, 9 kg: pro Waschgang incl. Waschpulver € 4,--

You have 1 electric waterkettle and dishes available in your room, also 2 cookingplates are available. 
The used dishes you can clean in the guest dishwasher in the bathroom,  a microwave and a fridge are available in the corridor.
Kitchen is not shared.
Washingmachine ( 9 kg), one using per week is free,  € 4,-- per each using more than one time.

Die Gesamtsumme der Untermiete ist inklusive aller Betriebs- und Nebenkosten, sowie Heizung, Warmwasser, Strom und Beleuchtung.  
Des Weiteren ist enthalten: Internet, Rundfunkgebühren und ein Netflixzugang.
MELDEPFLICHT
Entweder ist ein Meldezettel auszufüllen, oder bei längerem Aufenthalt eine Anmeldung im Kreisverwaltungsreferat vorzunehmen. Hierzu erhalten Sie von mir eine sogenannte "Wohnungsgeberbescheinigung".
The Rent  ist inclusiv all operating and extra costs, warm water, electric energy, broadcast fee, Internet and a netflix access, if you want.

REGISTRATION
I need to see your Passport, for the registration. If you have no permanent residence in Germany, you have to fill in a registration form, or in the case you will stay longer, you will get a so called "Wohnungsgeberbescheinigung" for KVR, where you have to registrate your residence in my flat.

Dank ausgezeichneter Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel (U-Bahn, S-Bahn, Tram und Bus) sind Sie in wenigen Minuten bei allen weltbekannten Sehenswürdigkeiten, die München kulturell, sportlich und architektonisch zu bieten hat. Zum Hauptbahnhof, Marienplatz und Stachus sind es nur 10-15 Minuten. Und falls Sie sich für das Oktoberfest interessieren: die weltgrößte Kirmes findet jedes Jahr Ende September genau zu Ihren Füßen statt: Sie brauchen nur über die Straße gehen! Ob Sie geschäftlich in München verweilen, studieren oder eine private Auszeit nehmen: Hier haben Sie ein neues behagliches Hideaway gefunden, dass Sie sofort in Ihr Herz schließen werden! Und um das Putzen brauchen Sie sich auch nicht kümmern: wir reinigen Ihr Zuhause 1x wöchentlich (inklusive). Noch Fragen? Wir führen Sie gerne persönlich durch Ihr neues kleines Heim. Rufen Sie uns an!

title: Walter-Gropius-Straße, Munich
description:
Serviced Apartment - A piece of home for a few months? 

Whether you are traveling for work, traveling or just need a nice place to stay for a long time: We master the balancing act between hotel and living. In our fully and smartly furnished apartments you get high-quality furnishings and an individual service 
The up to 20m2 large studios have beds with a width of 1.40m. The room is divided into a living and sleeping area, a kitchenette and a bathroom. 
Facilities include u.a. a Flatscreen- TV, dishwasher, microwave and much more. The fully equipped kitchenette includes a toaster, fridge and stovetop. There is also a coffee machine and a kettle. The studios also have a high-speed WiFi connection. Laundry Room: Washing machines and dryers can be shared (fee required). The studios are cleaned once a week and the final cleaning is included. 

----
*Uncomplicated CheckIn on the day of arrival*.

1 week before arrival you will receive an email with further information for the day of arrival as well as instructions for using the app and the checkin kiosk.

1)	Do you already use the free app "Hotelbird" for PreCheckIn and room card? 

With the app, you can check in on the day of arrival while on the move. Enter the booking number and last name of the booking and follow the instructions in the app. 

Through the app, you use your phone as a key and can no longer lose it.

For the use of the app you need to activate the Bluetooth function!!

2)	You want to check in on site first?

Our checkin-kiosk is also available around the clock.
Have your booking number and last name of the booking ready and follow the instructions on the screen.

++Please note that you can only create your room card via app or checkin-kiosk after 2 pm.++

We are available for you by phone around the clock. If you would like to speak to a member of staff on site, please refer to the notices at the reception desk in the building.

----
Neighborhood
- Ideal traffic connection at the end of the motorway A9 
- Top connections to the public (tram 23 "Anni-Albers-Str.", U6 "Alte Heide" & bus line 50 "AlfredArndt-Straße") 

---
Please note that the pictures given are sample pictures and there may be deviations in the equipment and bed sizes for booked studios.

title: Aindorferstraße, Munich
description:
Bitte beachten Sie, dass HousingAnywhere eine Online-Buchungsplattform ist. Daher ist es nicht möglich, Kontaktdaten auszutauschen und Besichtigungen anzubieten. Wenn Sie diese Unterkunft reservieren möchten, senden Sie mir eine Buchungsanfrage oder eine Nachricht!

Please note that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform. Therefore it is not possible to change contact data or do viewings prior to booking. If you want to reserve this place, send me a booking request or a message!

The cozy  bedroom (approx. 17m2) is well furnished, with closets, bedside table, chair and chest of drawers. Also under the bed itself there are two huge drawers with lots of storage space.
You can also look forward to a king-size bed with a new barrel spring mattress including a topper. The lovely second room (approx. 10m2) is also very well equipped with wardrobes, a space-saving foldaway bed and a huge desk. It is still being renovated - photos will follow shortly. The windows of both rooms (as well as the kitchen) face the green, quiet inner courtyard - although conveniently located, you can hardly hear anything about Munich, so you can start your days well rested.

The kitchen is also fully equipped with an oven, sink, dishwasher, washing machine, side-by-side refrigerator, kettle mixer and much more. The bathroom is small but nice and above all clean...

The rest of the apartment is also fully furnished. Living room with 60 inch Flat-TV, WLAN and High-speed Internet and cable TV as well as Amazon Prime are already included in your rent. A, for Munich standards almost impudent, large balcony is also included - except for a good mood you don't need to bring anything with you :-)

We have an underground parking garage (on request for 60 euros per month) and a bicycle cellar, as well as an elevator in the house. The connection to public transportation is as ingenious as the proximity to the Westpark/Theresienwiese/Westbad/Pasing Arcaden/...

____________________________________________________________________________________________

Das Zimmer (ca. 17m2) ist bestens eingerichtet, mit Kleiderschränken, Nachttisch, Stuhl und Kommode. Auch unter dem Bett selber gibt es zwei riesige Schubfächer mit viel Stauraum.
Freuen kannst du dich außerdem auf ein Kingsize-Bett mit neuer Tonnenfederkernmatratze inkl. Topper. Auch das zweite Zimmer (ca. 10m2) ist mit Schränken, einem platzsparendem Schrankbett sowie einem riesigen Schreibtisch bestens ausgestattet. Es wird momentan noch renoviert- Fotos folgen in Kürze. Die Fenster beider Zimmer (sowie der Küche) gehen zum grünen, ruhigen Innenhof - obwohl sehr verkehrsgünstig gelegen, hört man von München so gut wie nichts, sodass du deine Tage ausgeschlafen starten kannst.

Die Küche ist ebenso voll ausgestattet mit Backofen, Spüle, Geschirrspülautomat, Waschmaschine, Side-by-Sidy-Kühlschrank, Wasserkocher Mixer uvm. Das Badezimmer ist klein aber fein und vor allem rein...

Auch der Rest der Wohnung ist voll möbliert. Wohnzimmer mit 60 Zoll Flat-TV, WLAN und High-speed-Internet und Kabelfernsehn sowie Amazon Prime sind schon in deinem Mietanteil enthalten. Einen, für Münchner Verhältnisse fast schon unverschämt, großen Balkon gibt es auch dazu - ausser guter Laune brauchst du rein theoretisch nichts mitbringen :-)

Wir haben eine Tiefgarage (nach Absprache für 69€ monatlich zusätzlich mietbar) und eine Fahrradkeller, sowie Fahrstuhl im Haus. Die Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel ist genauso genial wie die Nähe zum Westpark/Theresienwiese/Westbad/Pasing Arcaden/...

title: Belgradstraße, Munich
description:
Housinganywhere does not allow viewings or the exchange of Contact info before a booking.They guarantee the place is as it looks in the pictures else you receive your money back. The only way for you to see the place is to book it here. Then you will receive the phone nr. and the full address. A breach of the terms and conditions can have wide ranging negative implications. - If reactions are made with a different reason than solely coming to an agreement on renting a property listed on www.housinganywhere.com and with that in breach of the previous paragraph, the replier is liable to a fine of €1000 (say: one thousand euros) per reaction sent. 

We're renting out our one-bedroom apartment (living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, hallway + balcony) with 54 m2 centrally located in the Schwabing area of Munich. 

Location: The apartment is situated on the fourth floor, with elevator, in the Schwabing-West neighborhood between subway stops Scheidplatz (U2/U3) and Bonner Platz. Both are a 5min walk, and give you access to University, Marienplatz = city center or the main station in less than 10min. It is a 2min walk to tram lines 12 and 28. The view from the large windows and the balcony is towards the west into the directly adjacent Luitpoldpark and Olympiapark. Shopping (Penny and Rewe supermarkets, Basic bio market, dm drug store and several other small shops, pharmacy and doctors) are easily reached by foot 100-200m away. The dining and
bar district of Schwabing is few minutes by foot.

Facilities: The apartment is fully furnished in modern style, including dining table + chairs, sofa that expands into a queen size bed, desk, closets, flat TV with cable, bed (140x200cm), drawers, lamps, kitchen (with stove, oven, fridge, dishwasher). It includes a full set of housefold equipment (from ironing board to dishes to towels and linens). You can use a storage room in (hidden)ment. The apartment complex has a shared laundry room with coin-operated washing machines, tumble dryer and drying room and a bicycle storage room that you can use.

Rent: The all-inclusive monthly rent includes all utility (heating, electricity, cold and warm water, internet with DSL connection and WLAN, phone with unlimited plan for German landline connections).

The pictures shown were taken before the previous tenants moved in. Since then, a new building on the opposite side of the street has reduced the views from the window, and the kitchen stove has been renewed.

description:

description:
Zur Vermietung steht eine exklusive, hochwertig eingerichtete 1-Zimmer-Wohnung in absoluter Top-Lage von München.

Die Wohnung befindet sich in ruhiger Innenhoflage nahe der Fraunhoferstraße und verbindet zentrale Lage mit angenehmer Ruhe und Privatsphäre. Die Isar ist in nur ca. 5 Gehminuten erreichbar, ebenso die U-Bahn-Station Fraunhoferstraße mit optimaler Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr. Auch die Auer Dult sowie der Mariahilfplatz befinden sich in unmittelbarer Nähe. Zahlreiche Cafés, Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und das Münchner Stadtleben sind bequem fußläufig erreichbar.

Die Wohnung verfügt über ca. 35 m2 Wohnfläche und befindet sich im Erdgeschoss eines modernen Gebäudes mit zwei Aufzügen.

Unter anderem verfügt die Wohnung über ein exklusives Roche-Bobois-Doppelbett (160 cm x 200 cm), stilvolle Einrichtungselemente sowie einen 55-Zoll-Fernseher inklusive aktiver Netflix- und Disney+-Subscription.

Im Badezimmer befinden sich sowohl eine Waschmaschine als auch ein Trockner. Zusätzlich steht im Haus eine separate Waschküche zur Verfügung.

Ein Fahrradstellplatz ist ebenfalls vorhanden. Die Wohnung verfügt zudem über eine angenehme Fußbodenheizung sowie schnelles Internet mit bis zu 600 Mbit/s.

Die Wohnung eignet sich ideal für Berufstätige, Studierende, Expats oder Personen, die für einen gewissen Zeitraum stilvoll und zentral in München wohnen möchten.
